items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hank was playing in that band when it first started... he was in that band, man, Hank.

ctx.x: And I ain‘t never played with no band, this band don‘t out play Thad and Mel Lewis‘s band, Mel Lewis playing drums and Thad playing the trumpet and flugelhorn and conducting out there. And Thad was something else, man. Great guy, man. Thad, I don‘t know, I don‘t know why we lost Thad, man. Thad wasn‘t that old or anything. He did few things that were probably against his health or something. Because he was a pretty strong guy, he was strong, you know? He wasn‘t no weak guy by no means, but I don‘t know, just like…
